verdict.rationale: A file-conversion SaaS that also offers AI-driven processing could fairly be asked whether it lets users stop their data being used for model training, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI training use, opt-outs, or a no-training policy. The 'files and conversions remain private' line only describes team billing separation, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
